item.title: Stream Rating Curves and Jupyter Notebook
item.description:
I wrote this a few years ago on another blog, but I think it is still relevant so I am re-posting it here. The code is still available on Github.

I worked for several years at USU on the iUTAH project. While there I managed a network of water monitoring stations along the Logan river, and one component of my job involved measuring stream flow. We wanted to know how much water was flowing past each station in order to answer basic questions like “how much water is lost or gained downstream?”
